ACCOUNTABILITY_SHAPE: A V3 accountability callout does not have the expected shape (heading, stamp, body, summary line).
Restore the callout's shape; nothing was written.
ACCOUNTABILITY_VERIFY_FAILED: A V3 accountability write did not read back as written.
ACCOUNTABILITY_WRITE_OUT_OF_SCOPE: A write outside the callout was refused before it was sent.
ACCOUNTABILITY_DEGRADED: Jira could not be read for at least one person; that callout shows DEGRADED with its last accepted text.
None; retried on the next run.
ACCOUNTABILITY_TARGET_NOT_FOUND: A V3 register row is missing, or its callout is not on the Jim & Matt V3 page.
Restore the register row; nothing was written.
ACCOUNTABILITY_SUMMARY_SHAPE: A V3 summary page does not hold exactly one paragraph.
Restore the page; nothing was written.
ACCOUNTABILITY_JIRA_BAD_PAGE: Jira returned a search page in an unexpected shape.
None; retried on the next run.
ACCOUNTABILITY_JIRA_TOO_MANY_PAGES: A Jira search needed more pages than the bound allows.
None; retried on the next run.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_GOAL_AMBIGUOUS: One MEJ project Epic is linked to multiple current-quarter goal Epics, so attribution is ambiguous.
Correct the Jira Relates links with Matt's approval; the V3 goal update was refused.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_COMPLETION_DATE_MISSI: A linked MEJ project Task is Done but Jira has no status-category transition date; quarter attribution cannot be proven.
Keep prior V3 summary; verify Jira status history before publishing a versioned metric.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_COMPLETION_HISTORY_UN: A v2 MEJ Done Task has no complete, verified first transition into Done in Jira history.
Keep previous KPI; inspect complete Jira changelog and reconcile the first Done transition.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_MEMBERSHIP_NOT_APPROV: The quarter's frozen MEJ Task-to-goal baseline is missing, malformed or not approved.
Record and approve an exact immutable quarter membership matrix before enabling v2.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_MEMBERSHIP_DRIFT: A frozen MEJ Task's type, parent, goal link or existence differs from the approved quarter baseline.
Stop v2 KPI publishing; reconcile Jira with the approved frozen baseline.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_METRIC_VERSION_INVALI: MEJ metric mode must be v1 or v2; no other value is allowed.
Keep v1 until K2/K3 validation and approved v2 cutover are complete.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_MEMBERSHIP_MISS: The frozen quarter membership list for the v2 promotion check is missing or empty.
Approve the frozen list (LIFE-918); v2 stays preview and legacy stays official.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_MEMBERSHIP_INCO: Not every Task on the frozen quarter list is counted in v2, so eligible membership is below 100%.
Find the missing Tasks; v2 stays preview.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_DUPLICATE_ATTRI: A Task is attributed to more than one goal, or counted twice, in the v2 figures.
Fix the attribution; v2 stays preview.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_COMPLETION_DATE: A completion date is missing, ambiguous or not the first verified transition into Done from the Jira changelog.
Read the full changelog for that Task; v2 stays preview.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_HISTORY_DRIFT: The historical v1 figures differ before and after the v2 change.
Find what changed history; v2 stays preview.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_RECURRING_NOT_D: Manual and automatic recurring closures overlap or do not add up to the reported total.
Keep the two kinds apart; v2 stays preview.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_TOLERANCE_EXCEE: More than one unexplained Task discrepancy on a board in the quarter.
Explain the discrepancies with a record (who, what, source) or fix them; v2 stays preview.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_INPUT_INVALID: The promotion check inputs are missing, malformed or could not be read (or the time had no zone).
Fix the reader; v2 stays preview.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_SETTER_UNAVAILA: The check passed twice but the V2_OFFICIAL row could not be set.
Check the Runtime Configuration row and the integration's edit access; legacy stays official.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_ALERT_FAILED: The one Agent Inbox alert for a failed promotion check could not be delivered.
Retried on the next reconciliation run.
RUNTIME_CONFIG_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED: A write to a Runtime Configuration row other than V2_OFFICIAL was refused before any read.
None: only V2_OFFICIAL may be written.
RUNTIME_CONFIG_WRITE_ROW_MISSING: The V2_OFFICIAL row is missing or inactive in Runtime Configuration.
Restore the row; nothing was written.
RUNTIME_CONFIG_WRITE_ROW_REPEATED: Two active V2_OFFICIAL rows exist in Runtime Configuration.
Remove the duplicate; nothing was written.
RUNTIME_CONFIG_WRITE_VERIFY_FAILED: The V2_OFFICIAL write did not read back as written.
Legacy stays official; Jim checks the row.
ACCOUNTABILITY_CLOSURE_EVIDENCE_MISSING: A closed issue lacks its resolution or labels, so cancellations cannot be told from delivered work.
Nothing was written; the region is stamped DEGRADED and keeps its last body until the evidence reads.
ACCOUNTABILITY_CLOSURE_EVIDENCE_CONTRADI: A closed issue's resolution and labels contradict each other (superseded but resolved Done, or auto-closed but cancelled).
Nothing was written; the region is stamped DEGRADED until a person fixes the issue.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_MEMBERSHIP_INCOMPLETE: An approved v2 membership key lacks its reason, approval or effective date.
Complete the membership row (reason, approval, effective date) in the existing membership file; the v2 column stays unavailable until then.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_SNAPSHOT_INCOMPLETE: A closed quarter's published snapshot is missing its version or a goal's figures.
Restore the published snapshot in the membership file; the closed quarter is never recounted.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_BASELINE_GAP: The Q4 baseline for a goal has incomplete evidence, so no figure is reconstructed.
Report the gap; add evidence to the membership file only when Jim or Matt approves it.
ACCOUNTABILITY_WEEK_SPRINT_UNREAD: An overdue issue in a future sprint has no readable sprint name.
Nothing was written; the week region is stamped DEGRADED and keeps its last body until the sprint reads.
ACCOUNTABILITY_PROMOTION_STABILITY_UNAVA: The check passed but the 24-hour stability record could not be read or written, so nothing was promoted.
Fix the database connection; the next daily pass starts a new window and legacy stays official.
RUNTIME_CONFIG_PROOF_EXPECTATION_MISMATC: The same-value setter proof found V2_OFFICIAL not off, or at another revision than approved, so no request was sent.
Nothing changed; re-read the row and ask for a new approval at the revision it holds.
RUNTIME_CONFIG_PROOF_UNVERIFIED: The same-value setter proof was refused, could not be read back, or the page differed after the request.
Stop: the request is never repeated; report the run and check the row by hand.
